data.narrative:
Arena AI is a Series B–stage defense and security technology company that has raised $62M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms across the same sector and stage, including Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), and Heven AeroTech ($1.0B).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a baseline proxy, applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $118M. Peer-median analysis across the 6 most directly comparable same-stage, same-sector companies produces a median valuation of $1.1B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B.

Triangulation of these methods supports a valuation range of $100M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $621M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Arena AI's competitive positioning, customer traction, and defensibility relative to the peer set. The gap between stage-progression and peer-median methods is particularly pronounced, suggesting that scaling trajectory and market differentiation will be critical to narrowing this range. Further diligence on revenue run-rate and customer concentration would be essential to refine the valuation toward the upper or lower bound.
